title: Exotelcraft latest news!
description:
EXOTELCRAFT - 6.6.1

A new version is here with support for 26.3 and several bug fixes!

Happy exploring!

CHANGES IN: 6.6.1
- [26.3] Added Exotelcraft blocks and items to the new 26.3 vanilla tags.
- [26.3] Made changes to mod data (such as features, tags, and carvers) due to 26.3 updates; this may affect the generation of some things.
- [26.3] Added missing things to the Bedrock Text Field.
- [26.3] The used-hand fix during entity transformation is now enabled by default without the `exotelcraft:better_transformation` game rule, due to changes in hand-swinging code.
- [26.3] Villagers from 1.13.2 still sell the old map types.
- [26.1] Added support for newer Sodium versions; older versions will no longer work with Exotelcraft.

FIXED BUGS IN: 6.6.1
- [26.3] Fixed Exotelcraft recipe advancements.
- [26.2+] Fixed the rendering of certain translucent entities, such as the Sulfur Cube in Mob Trophies from 25w14craftmine.
- Fixed Ender Map markers appearing in the world when the map was not in the inventory in Survival mode.
- Fixed being able to craft 3x3 recipes in the inventory when 3x3 crafting had not been unlocked via the recipe book in 25w14craftmine.

----------------------------------------

EXOTELCRAFT - 6.6.0

A new version is here with an updated numbering system and new experimental features for Exotelcraft 7.0.0!

Happy exploring!

CHANGES IN: 6.6.0
- Slightly updated the version numbering system. For example, `6.6.0-RELEASE` is now simply `6.6.0`.
- Added an experimental toggle for the 7.0.0 update. Currently, blogre and flonre trees have been updated, and the Flonre Rose Bush has been added.
- Removed the `LICENSE_ReimaginedMenus` file from the .jar, as it was unused.
- Backported `minecraft:poplar_foliage_placer` from 26.3.
- Removed unused `exotelcraft:exotel_noise` noise settings.
- Added the missing Trident recipe to 24w14potato and disabled Dent if 24w14potato isn't enabled.

FIXED BUGS IN: 6.6.0
- Fixed an issue where the Bedrock Style UI Create New World screen did not work when there were no existing worlds.
- Fixed an issue when using 25w14craftmine where biomes generated from world effects didn't work properly, often resulting in missing mine exits and things from world effects. (This was especially common in 26.2.)
- [26.2] Fixed some mine ingredients not unlocking in 25w14craftmine.
- [26.2] Fixed the fire on hands effect not rendering for the "You Are the Campfire" player unlock in 25w14craftmine.

----------------------------------------

EXOTELCRAFT - 6.5.0 RELEASE

A new version is here for 26.2 with LTS for 26.1! This update adds 26w14a April Fools' snapshot features, expands the Bedrock Style UI, and makes improvements to the Ender Map, such as visible in-world markers and other tweaks. It also adds other things and fixes big bugs.

Happy playing!

CHANGES IN: 6.5.0 RELEASE
- Added 26w14a (W.I.P.).
- The Exotelcraft Options, Exotelcraft Hub, Create New World, and Edit World screens now have a new look in the Bedrock Style UI.
- Made some changes to the Bedrock Style UI elements.
- Ender Map now shows players if the locator bar is enabled.
- Changed how item disabling works so it now behaves more like vanilla disabled items.
- Added the "Better April Fools'" option to Exotelcraft Options.
- "Entering Mine...", "Entering Mine in: X seconds", "No longer entering Mine", "MINE COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY", and "MINE FAILED" in 25w14craftmine now display their text effects.
- Added the ability to add world effects for 25w14craftmine using datapacks.
- Added the ability to add mine item exchange values for 25w14craftmine using datapacks.
- Removed `exotelcraft:old_multi_noise` as it was no longer used.
- All Lightning Rods now have an exchange value for 25w14craftmine.
- Added descriptions for some April Fools' game rules that were missing them.
- [26.2] Added the `exotelcraft:frost_magma_cube_immune_to` block tag.
- Removed the mention of ReimaginedMenus in the LICENSE file, as its code is no longer used.
- Removed the behavior where the world creation screen automatically opened in the Bedrock-style UI when no worlds had been created.
- Removed the "Loaded UI component definition: <id>" log message.
- [26.2] Made some minor changes to the generation of Exotel Dripstone and Blue Crystal Geodes to adapt to changes in 26.2.

FIXED BUGS IN: 6.5.0 RELEASE
- [NeoForge] Fixed Exotelcraft not working on NeoForge.
- [NeoForge] Fixed a crash with Sodium.
- Fixed several mixin issues that caused certain features to not work correctly due to internal errors after updating to 26.1 (such as incorrect Exotel fog, wrong camera distance if a player is transformed into an entity, and other minor bugs).
- Fixed mipmaps on many Exotelcraft blocks, such as leaves.
- Fixed Exotelcraft keybinds not persisting after restarting the game.
- Fixed a crash with the Sophisticated Backpacks and Sophisticated Storage mods.

----------------------------------------

EXOTELCRAFT - 6.4.0 RELEASE

Exotelcraft for Minecraft 26.1 is here! Fabric and NeoForge are now unified into a single jar for easier installation. The 25w14craftmine content is now complete, plus added new Exotelcraft wood shelves and more Bedrock UI components. Includes Lithium compatibility and a bunch of important bug fixes!

Happy playing!

CHANGES IN: 6.4.0 RELEASE
- Fabric and NeoForge versions are now unified into a single .jar file! No more separate mod files for each mod loader!
- The 25w14craftmine is now nearly complete (minor details, such as the progressively enlarging mine-entering text, are still missing).
- Added shelf variants for Exotelcraft wood types.
- Removed certain blocks from the "Exotelcraft - Building Blocks" Creative Mode tab, as they did not belong there.
- Added more Bedrock UI components and updated the appearance of the Exotelcraft options menu.
- Removed the #exotelcraft:farmlands tag, as it is no longer needed.
- Made various updates and adjustments to tags.
- When the exotelcraft:better_april_fools and exotelcraft:25w14craftmine game rules are enabled, biome tags are now added to generated biomes, allowing features like structures to generate.
- Recipes for disabled items are now disabled across more recipe types (this is no longer limited to just crafting).
- The mod now automatically sets mixin.entity.collisions=false in the Lithium configuration file (if present) to ensure compatibility with Exotelcraft.
- Renamed the exotelcraft:frying_table block entity to minecraft:frying_table to correct a naming error.
- The ability to download and update mods has been removed from the CurseForge version due to their policies. It is only available in the Modrinth version now.

FIXED BUGS IN: 6.4.0 RELEASE
- Fixed an issue where standing on a Frosty Magma Block would not apply the freezing effect.
- Fixed another issue with biome colors on chunk edges on the Ender Map.
- [NeoForge] Fixed an issue where the Hub world preset could not be reset on the Create World screen.
- Fixed the Netherite Sword rendering for the Pet Wolf (25w14craftmine).
- Fixed the `follow_exit_eye` advancement displaying in the advancements menu even when the 25w14craftmine was disabled.
- Fixed an issue where Recipe Book advancements for disabled items were not properly disabled (they were still being awarded).
- Implemented various bug fixes for the 25w14craftmine.
- [NeoForge] Fixed Wild Cherries and 3D Shareware v1.34 barrels failing to generate.
- Fixed a crash related to the Lithium mod.

----------------------------------------

EXOTELCRAFT - 6.3.0 RELEASE

A new version is here! No additional libraries are required anymore. Spears for mod materials have been added, the Bedrock Style UI has been overhauled and is now enabled by default, and more 25w14craftmine features have been included. Plus, various other improvements and bug fixes!

Happy playing!

CHANGES IN: 6.3.0 RELEASE
- [Fabric] Fabric API is no longer required!
- [NeoForge] Kriforfab is no longer required!
- When fabric-item-group-api-v1 is missing on Fabric, a new Creative Tabs system will be enabled in Creative mode.
- Bedrock Style UI is now enabled by default and related strings have been updated.
- The Bedrock Style UI has been overhauled. The Bedrock Title Screen and many other elements are now defined via JSON, along with many other UI changes.
- Added Opal, Ruby, and Upgraded Ruby Spears.
- Added missing translation key for minecraft:grid_carrier.
- [Fabric] Re-added datafixers for entities and block entities from the mod.
- Shipwrecks now generate in the Potato Dimension as they did in the 24w14potato snapshot.
- Pillager patrols no longer spawn in the Potato Dimension as they didn't in the 24w14potato snapshot.
- Added in-game mod updater.
- Corrupted Ender Map regions will now regenerate.
- Some Ender Map related improvements.
- Packed Ice now generates instead of Lava in Exotel caves.
- Upgraded Ruby weapons and tools are now fire resistant.
- The Experiments button has been removed from Exotelcraft options.
- [NeoForge] Added "Not available on NeoForge." message to the 25w14craftmine option tooltip.
- [NeoForge] Prevented creating worlds on NeoForge when the Hub (25w14craftmine) world preset or 25w14craftmine game rule is selected. A warning dialog now appears explaining the restriction with an option to reset the conflicting settings.
- April Fools' internal variables now reset when you disconnect.
- Some translation corrections.
- Some small changes.

FIXED BUGS IN: 6.3.0 RELEASE
- Fixed crouching on minecraft:grid_carrier.
- Some other fixes related to minecraft:grid_carrier.
- Fixed "You died!" text in the Death Screen when Bedrock Style UI is enabled.
- Fixed "Failed to read <world_path> lock" when using the back button in the Bedrock Edit World screen.
- Fixed "Failed to load map region r.x.x.nbt" spam when the Ender Map region file was corrupted.
- Fixed Potatification enchantment appearing when the 24w14potato gamerule was disabled (if it somehow still appears, it won't function).
- Fixed broken biome blending on chunk edges in the Ender Map.
- Some other fixes with the Ender Map.
- Fixed some issues with April Fools' syncing which would cause a crash when joining a server (LAN world) with 25w14craftmine enabled.
- Some small fixes.
